Fix: ot_rst_pipe (pin synchroniser + per-region 2-stage flop chains for the 8 control regions and each of the 12 hard tiles), io_flop_at_pins cols 8. Rest as q13: hardened reciprocal leaf in the east column with 2+2 seam relays; benches exact PASS / pbmut FAIL were green on q13.
